study: FORWARD test: would starting the desk at 10:30 instead of 09:45 help? Are fills entered 09:45-10:30 ET worse than fills entered 10:30-15:30?
registered_at: 2026-10-07, before any session from 2026-10-08 is scored
origin: Operator 10/7 after the loss-by-source review. 10:00-10:30 was the worst half-hour in the 9/23-10/02 cost review (-19.9 bp t -6.2; -52.4 bp t -3.3) and again for movers since 9/29 (-16.3 bp, 28 fills). Chosen after looking, so only new sessions can test it.
data: ai_reports/outcomes.jsonl on the mini: every closed desk round trip (all sources) with entry_time on sessions 2026-10-08 onward; realized bp = (exit_price / entry_price - 1) x 1e4 (the desk's real fills and exits)

groups.EARLY: entry_time in [09:45:00, 10:30:00) ET (what a 10:30 start removes)

statistic: OLS of realized bp on a SLOT dummy with day fixed effects; day-clustered (CR1) t
pass: EARLY minus REST <= -5 bp with t <= -2, with >= 60 EARLY fills over >= 10 sessions, AND the sign holds in both the first and second half of the sessions. Then (skeptic review first) a pre-registered paper A/B of a 10:30 start. Otherwise no change.
information_only: EARLY and REST mean, median, win rate, $ per day
EARLY's share of fills and of the day's $ result
prior: the 10/3 cost review found a 10:00 or 10:30 start changed per-trade net only -8.8 -> -8.2 bp
note: a skip only helps if the slot is WORSE THAN OTHER TIMES; while every trade loses on average, removing any trades lowers the daily dollar loss, which is not evidence for this slot
config_changes: any config change during the test (e.g. the 10/15 cost-arm decision) is recorded; day fixed effects absorb day-level shifts; the test is also reported split at each change
no_retuning: the window, the REST definition and the bar are fixed here
amended: 2026-10-07, before any forward session was scored (operator: 'why not just start at 10:30?'): primary changed from the 10:00-10:30 slot to the whole 09:45-10:30 window (the 10:30-start rule); the slot alone is information
amended_2: 2026-10-08 ~12:20 ET: OPERATOR OVERRIDE (option B) - the paper desk starts at 10:30 from 2026-10-09 (ai_entry_earliest_time 10:30), ahead of this test, on the in-sample evidence (9/1-10/8: 09:45-10:30 -41 bp/trade vs -13 rest, 20 of 24 days losing; 10/08 all-open session -6.7 bp) and against the 10/3 cost-review caution (-8.8 -> -8.2 bp). Consequence: from 10/09 live fills have no EARLY group, so the live test can only use 10/08 (1 session). The early window is measured instead in the nightly replay (variant start0945 = live config with a 09:45 start, vs the recorded 10:30 base): EARLY = start0945 trades entered 09:45-10:30, REST = its trades 10:30-15:30, same statistic and bar on replay trades, read at >= 10 replay sessions; reported with the replay-fidelity caveat. Reverse the override if the replay's EARLY minus REST is >= 0 over 10 sessions.
